_draft: DRAFT: a record with draft: true carries the planner's own wording (a gate's reason, a renamed step label), which awaits the user's approval.
_about: T-453: the planner. step on every record = how many of the story's steps are done before it is reachable; show a record when the save has done at least that many (count the done_flag of each step in planner_story.json, bits as profile_layout explains). Each map (by its folder, as maps.json names it) with its place, its type, its size in tiles, its edges (the maps beside it) and joins (every map a warp, edge, script or the ferry leads to, both ways); gate says what holds it until step. join_gates hold the way between two maps instead. Left out on purpose: every place the game means to be found by playing, the islands only a ticket reaches, what lives in DOLDRUM CAVE, hidden items, fixed encounters, the GUIDE and the UNDERSTANDINGS, the NOTEBOOK and its books, and any line of the game's text.
